headline: Small clean S windswell today, and a prime-angle long-period pulse worth watching Thursday.
today: Good-angle S at 1.4-1.8ft, short period so nothing to write home about, but cross-off dawn keeps it clean. Winds go cross to cross-on through the day, so morning is the play. Groveler or log, easy rippable stuff for the first sessions before it backs off.

daysToWatch.note: Size nudges up to 2.4ft with cross W winds staying manageable through the morning. Best combo of size and cleanliness early in the week.
Prime-angle SSE swell shows up at up to 9.7s and 2.5ft — the good direction Ditch wants. Cross-off in the morning is your window; afternoon SW builds to cross-on and 19mph by evening, so surf early.
Longer-period S lines hold up to 2.3ft with light SSW wind midday. Clean fun window in the afternoon if Thursday's swell lingers.
